scope: 11 spotlight/featured entries in dist/games.json plus landscape replacement covers for pes6, skate, simpsons and lemmings.
method: Official publisher / Steam CDN media (library_hero 1920x620, or a landscape store banner) preferred. Where the first pass did not find landscape media, the exact original title's own screenshot/key art is recorded and the limitation is stated. Every download validated by HTTP status, image/* content type, file signature (magic bytes) and header pixel dimensions. Nothing is invented: a target with no genuine source is recorded as a failure with its evidence.

cover.note: Catalogue covers use the 460px card width, not the 1280px hero floor.

correctionNote: Correction pass on primary-agent review (findings recorded, not inferred): (1) Steam app 19980 is the 2008 Prince of Persia reboot, not the 1990 original — the previous dos-prince-of-persia-1990 record asserted the opposite from the Steam listing name alone, with no image inspection. That source is rejected and removed from the approved mapping. (2) The dos-civilization screenshot is the Amiga AGA variant, not the DOS release the entry launches; it is not applied as hero art. (3) The dos-the-need-for-speed-sep-1995 source is an official wordmark, not hero media; the existing asset is retained for now. (4) The first pass claim that no landscape media exists for pes6 and simpsons was wrong; primary-supplied landscape sources were downloaded, header-decoded and hashed, and both now carry verified cover art. No image vision was run in any step.
imageVision: none — no automated or human visual inspection of any downloaded file was performed in this pass. Edition/title attribution rests on the cited source page, never on inspecting pixels. Claims previously derived from a storefront listing name alone have been corrected.

generatorDrift: Resolved: scripts/fetch-hero-refresh.mjs restores only currently referenced, reviewed sources and rejects changed bytes by SHA256. It cannot revive rejected source definitions.
caveat: Byte-level validation proves a file is a real image of the stated format at the stated dimensions and that its bytes hash as recorded. It does NOT prove the image depicts the named game/edition — no image vision was run in any step — and it does not prove any right to host, stream, frame or monetise the destination. This run does not edit dist/games.json; wiring the assets in is a separate step.

primaryVisualReview.method: Primary inspected local contact sheets with all downloaded hero and cover assets; rejected wrong-edition Prince of Persia and reviewed final cover crops.
primaryVisualReview.limits: Some assets are publisher collection or franchise artwork rather than screenshots of the browser build. Lemmings is a native-resolution Amiga screenshot representing the original title.
